notes.title: Full Release - 1.0.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you![/h2]

I just wanted to take a second to thank everyone who took the time to download and play Let's Pet Pets in Early Access. I had a great time making LPP the best pet petting experience possible with your help and I hope that everyone enjoyed coming along for the ride.

The game is now out of Early Access and I will continue to push updates to fix bugs, balance, and make other changes that will improve the experience. If you have any questions, comments, or requests please reach out in the community tab or on the community discord. Thank you all for everything!

notes.title: Early Access - 0.1.8 - Goodbye Town
notes.notes:
[h2]Goodbye Town[/h2]
It was a hard decision to make, but the town building system took up too much development time to release consistent updates to the game. It was a cool idea, but it was not fleshed out enough to be anything more than a glorified menu for unlocking new pet groups.

[b]Pet groups will now be automatically unlocked simply by ascending[/b]. I know that this decision will upset some of you who have grown fond of your little pet town, but in order to continue creating the best pet petting experience possible it was important for me to re-evaluate the games core features and cut the fat.

[h2]Other things[/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Added milestones for combos
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access - 0.1.0 - ASCENSION
notes.notes:
[u][b]HAPPY INTERNATIONAL PETS DAY![/b][/u]

Welcome to the first major update to Let's Pet Pets. It's been a long road getting this release ready to go out to you all. Ascension is a new system that will change the way you play the game and unlock progress. Through completing milestones you will be able to gain ascension experience. This can be used to ascend. Ascending will reset almost everything. Pet levels, upgrades, quests, etc. But you will keep your heart levels and you will also keep the pets that you have unlocked. You will however gain things from prestiging. 

First and foremost you will gain new buildings that you can build in your town. Building new corrals will unlock more pet types. You will also increase your maximum heart level that pets can reach and you will also increase the maximum level that you can upgrade your upgrades to.

notes.title: Early Access - 0.0.3 - Day/Night, Nicknames, and New Legendary Pet
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you to the community for sticking with me[/h2]
I have been trying to figure out why there is no Add to Cart or Buy option on the Steam store for Let's Pet Pets. I have contacted support and am waiting eagerly to hear back from them to resolve this issue. In the meantime please join the [url=https://discord.gg/NWNpGAbXDV]Discord server[/url] and let me know what you want to see in future updates.

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a Day/Night cycle to the game (Based on Realtime)
[*] Pets can now have an affinity for certain times of day (increasing pet point production)
[*] Added ability to rename pets as suggested by [u]DarkestDemon[/u] on Discord
[*] Added a new Legendary dog as a pet in honor of the curator [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36690498-Can-You-Pet-the-Dog/]Can You Pet the Dog[/url]
[/list]
